=== Lead photograph (31 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of the right-hand adult man in a Facebook photograph posted 20 May 2025. The Facebook photo viewer names Matt Duncan. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group (group member since 5 September 2021, added by Jim Colson). Gold 101 Gardendale, Alabama. The diploma in the photograph is from Gardendale High School. A comment by Kelly Duncan calls it a family photograph. He posted selling a sealed Hoth Japanese 2-player set in the group. Dest the crop of Matt; do not dest Kelly Duncan or the two graduates as the lead. The uncropped original stays in Photographs. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Matt Duncan portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Matt Duncan Facebook portrait.jpg]].
